fusions.name: Run Out the Battery
fusions.desc: Looses 5 shots in a fanned salvo; each one deals 25 damage and ignores armour.

fusions.name: Swivel Piece
fusions.desc: Fires a shot into the first enemy it meets, and it deals 5 damage.

fusions.name: Powder Monkeys
fusions.desc: Your attack speed rises by 30% for 12 seconds, and you move 15% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Chase Guns
fusions.desc: After you cover enough ground, a shot fires at the nearest enemy within 8 tiles and deals 8 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
